5.1 Description
The F&P Eson TM is a respiratory mask which is non-invasive. The silicone seal is positioned
over the nose and it seals on the area around the nose and the upper lip. The mask is held
on the face with headgear straps. It connects to a single breathing tube via a swivel adaptor
to received pressurized gases. On the elbow are exhalation vents (bias holes) that allow
exhaled gases to be continually flushed and removed to room air. The F&P Eson TM Nasal
Mask has a diffuser system that is designed to diffuse air that is expelled from the mask>
This reduces the draft. The diffuser does not significantly change the amount of air flowing
from the mask, therefore the mask can be used With or without the diffuser system. The air
may also be humidified and/or oxygen enriched.
An oxygen pressure port accessory is available to be used with the device for oxygen
therapy and/or gas monitoring (previously covered by K003894 Fisher & Paykel Healthcare
Limited Oracle Oral Mask).
5.2 Intended Use
The F&P Eson Nasal Mask is intended to be used by individuals who have been diagnosed
by a physician as requiring CPAP or Bi-Level Ventilator treatment. The F&P Eson Nasal
Mask is intended for single-patient adult use in the home and multiple-patient adult use in thehospital or other clinical setting where proper disinfection of the device can occur between
patient uses.
5.3 Technological Characteristics Comparison
The F&P Eson" Nasal Mask is very similar to the predicate Fisher & Paykel Healthcare
ZeStTM Nasal Mask. Both masks are intended for non-continuous ventilation via CPAP and
Bi-Level therapy, and deliver CPAP gasses through the nose.
The main difference is the seal; the F&P Eson TM has a self-adjusting rolling bridge, marketed
as the RoilFit Seal, for relieving pressure on the bridge of the nose and strategicallythickened and thinned sections for overall structure, support and cushioning, whereas the
Ze StTM relies on the foam for structure, support and cushioning. Other differences with the
F&P Eson TM include:
a A per manently attached ball elbow rather than a detachable swivel elbow used by the
Ze StTM for increase movement range.
* A diffuser system that is designed to diffuse air that is expelled from the mask. This
reduces the draft. The diffuser does not significantly change the amount of air flowing
from the mask, therefore the mask can be, used with or without the diffuser system
* Headgear similar to Ze StTM but with the addition of the crown straps which is
designed to go over the top of the. head for increased stability. This adds two more
adjustment points (six in total for F&P Eson TM ) as opposed to four for ZestTM.
Marketed as Efgofit Headgear.
a The use of the headgear as forehead cushions for the F&P EsonTM, rather than
silicone forehead pads used by the ZestM for less parts.
* Headgear clips are incorporated in the lower headgear straps for F&P Eson TM for
ease of use.

5.4 Non-Clinical Tests
Testing of the F&P EsonTM Nasal Mask was compared to the predicate Fisher & Paykel
Healthcare ZeStTM Nasal Mask for performance and biocompatibility. These tests
demonstrate substantial equivalence of the F&P EsonTm Nasal Mask to the predicate mask..
Copies of test reports are included in Appendix B.
5.5 Conclusion
The comparison of features, performance, and intended use demonstrate that the F&P.
EsonTm Nasal Mask is substantially equivalent to the predicate Fisher & Paykel Healthcare
ZeStTM Nasal Mask for performance and biocompatibility. The F&P EsonM Nasal Mask has
been demonstrated to be safe and effective for OPAP and Bi-Level ventilation therapy.
